visible_text_labels: 1. Ethically euthanize mouse according to IACUC standards.
2. Place the mouse on a sterile underpad.

3. Enucleate the eye by pressing 5/45 style tweezers on the orbital area to induce proptosis and then move tweezers to the eyes posterior to remove the eye (by gently pulling) while ensuring that the optical nerve is still intact.
note.key_distinguishing_features: This segment is distinctive as it displays a text-based instructional guide for enucleation procedures, with no visible actions or objects. The text emphasizes ethical considerations and specific procedural steps.
